<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "And to this one I look, to the poor and contrite of spirit" refers to the revelation of Atzmus through faith above intellect, unlike the faith below intellect which is also in Atzmus but without revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this which is written "And to this one I look, to the poor and contrite of spirit" after "The heavens are My throne etc.,"</t>
    <t s="2">even though also the faith that is below intellect is in the Awtsmoos</t>
    <t s="3">[as is understood from the well-known [statement]32</t>
    <t s="4">that this that the name "Shamayim" (Heaven) is fluent in the mouth of everyone is because the luminary is in revelation],</t>
    <t s="5">it is,</t>
    <t s="6">that "looking"</t>
    <t s="7">("And to this one I look")</t>
    <t s="8">is revelation</t>
    <t s="9">(like something that one sees with his eyes),</t>
    <t s="10">and the revelation of the Awtsmoos is33</t>
    <t s="11">in the faith that is above intellect.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the three categories of poverty and service correspond to the three categories of fruit of the tree: the first three years of orlah, the fourth year, and the fifth year, representing different levels of drawing down from Zeir Anpin into Malchus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that these three matters</t>
    <t s="3">[the poverty at the beginning of service,</t>
    <t s="4">the service of "The heavens are My throne etc.,"</t>
    <t s="5">and the poverty after the service of "The heavens are My throne"]</t>
    <t s="6">are analogous to the three categories in the fruits of the tree</t>
    <t s="7">(in our parshah34),</t>
    <t s="8">the three years of orlah,</t>
    <t s="9">the fourth year and the fifth year.</t>
    <t s="10">And the explanation of the matter is35,</t>
    <t s="11">that "land" is Malchus and "tree" is Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="12">and the planting of a tree in the land</t>
    <t s="13">("When you come into the land and you shall plant every tree of food"36)</t>
    <t s="14">is the drawing down of Zeir Anpin into Malchus.</t>
    <t s="15">For in this drawing down there are three levels.</t>
    <t s="16">For in the first three years,</t>
    <t s="17">Malchus receives only from the three last sefiros of Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="18">Netzach, Hod and Yesod.</t>
    <t s="19">And since the main aspect of these midos is that through them the influence comes into actuality37,</t>
    <t s="20">therefore,</t>
    <t s="21">also the midos of NeHi"Y are similar to Malchus38</t>
    <t s="22">which is the root and source of the created beings,</t>
    <t s="23">that they give place to yesh (somethingness),</t>
    <t s="24">and it is possible for there to be from them suckling for the external [forces].</t>
    <t s="25">For this is the connection of the explanation</t>
    <t s="26">(above)</t>
    <t s="27">that the first three years correspond to the three midos of NeHi"Y,</t>
    <t s="28">with the explanation39</t>
    <t s="29">that the first three years correspond to the three impure klipos,</t>
    <t s="30">for when Malchus receives only from NeHi"Y it is possible for there to be suckling for the three impure klipos.</t>
    <t s="31">And therefore the fruits of these three years are orlah and are forbidden for benefit.</t>
    <t s="32">And in the fourth year Malchus receives from Tiferes</t>
    <t s="33">(from its lower third or from its two thirds).</t>
    <t s="34">And therefore the fruits of the fourth year are holy, praises to Havayah40,</t>
    <t s="35">for "praise" is in Tiferes, as it is said41</t>
    <t s="36">"and they praise the name of Your glory."</t>
    <t s="37">And in the fifth year Malchus also receives from the upper third of Tiferes.</t>
    <t s="38">And this is "And in the fifth year etc. to add to you its produce"42,</t>
    <t s="39">for the four aspects of TNeHi"Y</t>
    <t s="40">(which are in the fourth year)</t>
    <t s="41">correspond to the four letters of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="42">and in the fifth year,</t>
    <t s="43">an addition of light is drawn from the point of the Yud,</t>
    <t s="44">Kesser.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that in divine service, the three categories correspond to levels of drawing down the midos into thought, speech, and action, where receiving only from NeHi"Y leads to a service of subjugation akin to faith below intellect without revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter of these three categories in the service of man,</t>
    <t s="2">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="3">that the matter of Malchus is the actual fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in actual deed,</t>
    <t s="4">in thought, speech and action.</t>
    <t s="5">And this that one fulfills Torah and mitzvos in actual deed is through the drawing down and revelation of the midos into thought, speech and action.</t>
    <t s="6">And there are three manners in this.</t>
    <t s="7">For when the drawing down is only from NeHi"Y</t>
    <t s="8">(these midos are only in relation to action),</t>
    <t s="9">behold, even though NeHi"Y are the thighs43</t>
    <t s="10">and legs that lead him to the proper place,</t>
    <t s="11">to go in the way of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="12">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="13">since he has no vitality in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="14">(for the vitality in Torah and mitzvos is specifically through love and fear),</t>
    <t s="15">therefore it is possible that in the course of time there will be a weakening in his service,</t>
    <t s="16">and especially in "sanctify yourself in that which is permitted to you"44,</t>
    <t s="17">and even to the point that from this he will come to forbidden things</t>
    <t s="18">(including also things forbidden for benefit45).</t>
    <t s="19">And therefore his service needs to be in a manner of subjugation (itkafya).</t>
    <t s="20">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="21">that it is analogous to the faith that is below intellect</t>
    <t s="22">(the poverty before the service of "The heavens are My throne"),</t>
    <t s="23">that also this faith is in the Awtsmoos except that there is no revelation of the Awtsmoos in it</t>
    <t s="24">(as above at the end of section 4).</t>
    <t s="25">And analogous to that which is explained in Likkutei Torah46</t>
    <t s="26">(regarding the matter of the three years of orlah according to their simple meaning),</t>
    <t s="27">that this that one breaks his desire and waits three years and fulfills the negative commandment of "three years they shall be orlah for you"36</t>
    <t s="28">is like the matter of "Modim anachnu lach" (We give thanks to You)41,</t>
    <t s="29">that the thanksgiving is "to You,"</t>
    <t s="30">to His Essence and Awtsmoos, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="31">except that this is not in a manner of praise,</t>
    <t s="32">for praise is revelation</t>
    <t s="33">[as brought in Likkutei Torah47</t>
    <t s="34">that "praise" (hilel) is an expression of illumination, like "by the light of His lamp" (behalo nero)48],</t>
    <t s="35">but only in a manner of thanksgiving,</t>
    <t s="36">concealment.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
